# Experiment Protocol

Use this protocol for an explicit controlled comparison against a fixed
baseline. It grants no authority to change the evaluated system or promotion
criteria.

## Establish the baseline

Run the unchanged system first. Record inputs, environment, metric, protected
invariants, artifact identity, and result. Preserve the best accepted artifact
separately from the current trial.

## Run an interpretable trial

For each iteration:

1. State one general hypothesis and expected observation.
2. Make one coherent change.
3. Validate structural integrity.
4. Run the same evaluation in a fresh or equivalently controlled environment.
5. Record the complete result, including regressions and limitations.
6. Keep, discard, or invalidate the candidate using the predeclared rule.

Keep a candidate only when the agreed metric improves without violating a
protected invariant. Keep an equal result only when the system becomes
demonstrably simpler. Otherwise retain the trial record and keep the previous
baseline.

If removing one exact evaluation item would erase the expected benefit, the
change is probably overfit. Prefer improvements that remove a class of
failures.
